Pakistan asks China for duty-free access for all its goods! 🇵🇰
According to Arab News, Pakistan's planning ministry said on Friday that Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal sought duty-free access to the Chinese market for all Pakistani goods to narrow a $19.6 billion bilateral trade deficit. In FY2025-26 Pakistan imported $22.34 billion from China but exported only $2.71 billion. The proposal, raised in Beijing with Zhou Haibing, vice chairman of China's National Development and Reform Commission, is a non-reciprocal arrangement separate from the existing free trade agreement, modelled on the zero-tariff access China gives African countries.
